newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical sales seen at $100 bln in 2000.
newsitem.headline: China chemical sales seen at $100 bln in 2000.

text.p: China's Ministry of Chemical Industry expects annual nationwide chemical sales to be worth more than $100 billion by 2000, the Xinhua news agency said.
China's growing market was attracting fierce interest from Western chemical producers, the news agency quoted Chemical Industry Minister Gu Xiulian as saying in a report late on Wednesday.
The use of overseas technology in chemical production should be balanced with development of Chinese technology to guarantee domestic research and to protect Chinese brands, Gu said.

Calls from many multinational chemical firms for larger stakes in joint ventures should remind their Chinese partners of the need for care in attracting overseas investment, she said but gave no details.

By the end of last year, direct overseas investment in the Chinese chemical industry amounted to around $2 billion, and the nation had 150 overseas-funded projects, each with an investment of over $10 million.
